name.en: Merit Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC students (colleges and professional institutions)
name.hi: SC/ST/OBC छात्रों के लिए मेरिट छात्रवृत्ति (कॉलेज और प्रोफ़ेशनल संस्थान)
name.hn: SC/ST/OBC students ke liye Merit Scholarship (college aur professional institutions)

department.en: Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, Govt of NCT of Delhi

summary.en: A yearly scholarship for SC, ST and OBC students in recognised colleges who scored at least 60% in the previous year.
summary.hi: मान्यता प्राप्त कॉलेजों में पढ़ने वाले SC, ST और OBC छात्रों के लिए सालाना छात्रवृत्ति, जिन्होंने पिछले साल कम से कम 60% अंक पाए।
summary.hn: Recognised college mein padhne wale SC, ST aur OBC students ke liye saalana scholarship, jinke pichhle saal kam se kam 60% marks aaye.

amount_text.en: Per year (hosteller / day scholar): degree and technical ₹20,000 / ₹12,000; postgraduate ₹24,000 / ₹15,000; diploma ₹15,000 / ₹9,000; certificate ₹12,000 / ₹8,000; general UG ₹12,000 / ₹8,000; general PG ₹15,000 / ₹9,000.
amount_text.hn: Har saal (hosteller / day scholar): degree aur technical ₹20,000 / ₹12,000; PG ₹24,000 / ₹15,000; diploma ₹15,000 / ₹9,000; certificate ₹12,000 / ₹8,000; general UG ₹12,000 / ₹8,000; general PG ₹15,000 / ₹9,000.

label.en: Belongs to SC, ST or OBC
label.hi: SC, ST या OBC वर्ग से हैं
label.hn: SC, ST ya OBC category se hain

label.en: Studying in a recognised college or institution
label.hi: मान्यता प्राप्त कॉलेज या संस्थान में पढ़ रहे हैं
label.hn: Recognised college ya institution mein padh rahe hain

label.en: At least 60% marks in the previous year
label.hi: पिछले साल कम से कम 60% अंक
label.hn: Pichhle saal kam se kam 60% marks

label.en: For OBC: family income up to ₹3,00,000 a year (no income limit for SC/ST)
label.hi: OBC के लिए: परिवार की सालाना आय ₹3,00,000 तक (SC/ST के लिए आय सीमा नहीं)
label.hn: OBC ke liye: parivaar ki saalana income ₹3,00,000 tak (SC/ST ke liye koi income limit nahi)

verification.notes: Drafted from /mnt sources file (official pages fetched 2026-11-23). Not yet checked field by field by a human, so status is partial (S1-03). Only about a third of the 2025-26 PDF was read; re-read fully before verifying. Conflicts left out: the summary-table PDF gives different day-scholar ranges and adds minorities (guidelines used instead); Delhi residence was required in 2020-21 but is not stated for 2024-25/2025-26, so it is not a rule here. Application portal and window not stated for merit, so official_url and dates are null. Income certificate is a prerequisite for OBC applicants only. Students getting this merit scholarship are not eligible for post-matric SC; tell users about that.
